title: OpenAI Pays $300 for Bug Granting Free Access to Paid Models
summary:
A researcher identified a vulnerability in OpenAI's authentication process that bypassed subscription requirements. Oliver Fish discovered a sandbox escape allowing users to access the company's paid AI models without a registered account or API key, for which OpenAI provided a $300 bounty. Fish stated he now has zero reason to report further vulnerabilities to the company after receiving the payment.

The low compensation for a flaw that granted free access to premium services drew criticism from the security community. Some observers noted that issuing minimal bounties for critical access vulnerabilities is a contradictory approach for a firm developing tools intended to transform the field of cybersecurity.
